nicknames: Home of the Black Opal Stakes

main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). A fair 1,815m turf course featuring a 400m home straight. Very fair layout giving all running styles a legitimate chance.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair across middle distances. Inside stalls 1–4 are advantageous in 1000m and 1200m dashes.

acton_synthetic.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise synthetic inner track. Favors early speed and inside positioning.
acton_synthetic.post_bias: Inside stalls 1–4 hold a clear advantage.

handicapping_angles.black_opal_stakes_class: During the Group 3 Black Opal Stakes ($250k) 2YO feature meeting in March, race class elevates to Sydney Metro grade (+4.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.sydney_metro_shippers: Sydney metropolitan trainers (Waterhouse & Bott, Chris Waller, Snowdens) frequently target Canberra feature meetings.
